integrity: The result is supported by a complete standard-library enumeration of all set maps, exact order-preservation tests, and a replayed sequence of 432 certified beat-point deletions. Literature comparisons are statement-level; unindexed literature remains a residual novelty risk.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite classification for the canonical six-point sphere model only. It does not claim an all-dimensional formula or identify classical mapping spaces with finite function spaces.
title: The null self-map component of the six-point finite sphere has an \(S^2\)-core
